name: Remote Code Execution (RCE)
source: Remote Code Execution (RCE)/Remote Code Execution (RCE) - Interview Questions & Answers.md

prompts.title: Q: RCE vs arbitrary file read vs SSRF?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**A:** **RCE** is **code execution**. **File read** discloses data; may **chain** to RCE via **LFI** + upload. **SSRF** abuses **outbound** requests; may **chain** to cloud metadata or **internal** exploit-**not** RCE by itself unless combined.

---

prompts.title: Q: How do you call ImageMagick or ffmpeg safely from a web app?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** **No** string shell; **allowlisted** arguments; **separate** worker with **no** network; **latest** patched binaries; **resource** limits; consider **re-encoding** in **isolated** **queue**; validate **file type** before tools run.

prompts.title: Q: How do you defend against deserialization RCE in Java?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**A:** Avoid **ObjectInputStream** on **untrusted** bytes; use **signed** formats; **JSON** + validated DTOs; **global** **denylist**/allowlist where framework supports; **patch** **gadget** libraries; **monitor** **unexpected** classes loaded.

---

prompts.title: Q: First three actions when RCE is confirmed in prod?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** (1) **Contain**: block IOCs, **isolate** instances, **preserve** evidence if needed. (2) **Patch** or **remove** vulnerable code path; **scale** to **clean** images. (3) **Rotate** **secrets** the process could read; **hunt** **persistence** and **lateral** movement.

prompts.title: Q: How do you prioritize “auth bypass” vs “RCE”?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**A:** **RCE** usually **wins** on urgency because **blast radius** and **trust** collapse-but **auth bypass** on **admin** can be **equal**. Use **exploitability**, **exposure**, **data** sensitivity, and **existing** **controls**.
